items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: I’m out with a band that I’ve loved since I was a kid, I’ve got heroes on that band: Frank Vicari who I knew from Maynard’s band, and Bobby Burgess and Al Porcino and Sal Nistico.

ctx.x: How did you adapt to living on a bus?

I loved it. You know 21 years old, I’m out with a band that I’ve loved since I was a kid, I’ve got heroes on that band: Frank Vicari who I knew from Maynard’s band, and Bobby Burgess and Al Porcino and Sal Nistico. And Woody, you know? So I loved — I didn’t mind it at all at first.
